ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: Your account is blocked. Please contact the school administration.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Please set a new password to continue.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this.
CONFLICT: This value is already in use.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
MEDIA_DISABLED: File storage is not available right now.
IMPORT_FILE_TOO_BIG: The file is too big (max 100 KB).
IMPORT_INVALID_CSV: This file is not a valid CSV. Save it from Excel as “CSV UTF-8”.
IMPORT_EMPTY: The file has no student rows.
IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows: up to 300 students per file.
IMPORT_MISSING_COLUMNS: Required columns are missing. Use the CSV template.
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: Some rows have errors. Fix them or turn on “Skip rows with errors”.
NO_CURRENT_YEAR: Set the current academic year in Settings first.
MARK_THRESHOLDS_ORDER: Marks must go down: 5 above 4, 4 above 3.
WEIGHTS_SUM: Homework, quizzes and exams must add up to 100%.
DATES_ORDER: The end date must be after the start date.
YEAR_OVERLAP: These dates overlap another academic year.
PERIODS_OUTSIDE_YEAR: Some periods of this year would fall outside the new dates. Change them first.
PERIOD_OUTSIDE_YEAR: The period must be inside its academic year.
PERIOD_OUTSIDE_PARENT: The period must be inside the period it belongs to.
PERIOD_PARENT_INVALID: The parent period must belong to the same year.
PERIOD_OVERLAP: These dates overlap another period of the same kind.
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.
UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
